login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Raise complaints with photos and follow them until fixed.
login.phoneHelp: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS.
login.photoAlt: The towers and garden courtyard of Runwal MyCity, Dombivli

errors.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new code.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

home.title: Complaints
home.emptyBody: When something needs fixing, raise it here with a photo.

raise.title: New complaint
raise.photosLead: A photo helps staff see the problem before they come.
raise.photoFailed: That photo could not be read. Try another.
raise.detailsHelp: When did it start? Anything staff should know?
raise.photosFailed: Some photos could not be uploaded: {{failed}} of {{total}}.
raise.errorGeneric: Could not raise the complaint. Check your connection and try again.
raise.errorNotYours: You can raise complaints only for your own flat or a common area.
raise.discardQuestion: Discard this complaint? Nothing has been sent yet.

account.VERIFIED: Register for your flat to start raising complaints.
account.PENDING: Your registration is waiting for the society’s approval.

detail.missingBody: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another flat.
detail.fixedBody: Staff marked this as resolved. If the problem is gone, close the complaint. If not, add a comment below.
detail.closeIt: Yes, it is fixed. Close it
detail.closeFailed: Could not close the complaint. Try again.
detail.commentHelp: Visible to everyone who can see this complaint.
detail.commentFailed: Could not send the comment. Try again.
detail.commentsOff: This complaint is finished, so comments are closed.

jobs.title: My jobs
jobs.lead: Assigned to you, the most urgent first.
jobs.emptyBody: New work appears here when an admin assigns it to you.

assign.title: To assign
assign.lead: New complaints waiting for someone to fix them, the most urgent first.
assign.emptyBody: Every new complaint has been assigned.

act.noStaff: No staff members yet. Give someone the staff role first.
act.startBody: Start when you begin the work, so the resident knows it is being handled.
act.noteHelp: For example: replaced the tap washer. The resident sees this.
act.closeForResident: Usually the resident confirms the fix. Close it yourself if they cannot.
act.reasonHelp: The resident sees this. For example: this is the flat owner’s own repair.
act.failed: That did not work. Someone may have changed it already: reload and try again.

signups.title: Sign-ups
signups.lead: People who registered for a flat. Check they live there before approving.
signups.approved: Approved. They can now raise complaints.
signups.rejected: Not approved. They have been told why.

register.welcome: Welcome. Tell us who you are and which flat you live in; the society checks and approves it, usually within a day.
register.nameHelp: As the society knows you. Only your name and flat are asked.
register.reviewNote: The society admin sees your name, flat and mobile number to check you live there.
register.waitingBody: The society admin will check your request. Once approved, you can raise complaints.
register.stillWaiting: Not decided yet. Check again later.
register.errorFlats: Could not load the flats of this tower. Try again.
register.errorGeneric: Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
register.errorRefused: This request could not be accepted. Check the flat and try again.

shift.title: My shift
shift.offHint: Start your shift when you begin work.
shift.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
shift.outside: Recorded {{km}} km from the society: your admin will review this.
shift.noLocation: No location was recorded: your admin will review this.

report.title: Staff report
report.lead: Complaints raised in the period and assigned to each staff member, how fast they were fixed, and hours on shift.
report.needsDates: Choose a start and an end date.
report.failed: The report could not be loaded.
report.nobodyOnDuty: Nobody is on shift right now.
report.emptyBody: Staff appear here once they have the staff role.
report.footnote: Times are medians from assignment. "On time" is the share of fixed complaints resolved within their SLA. Shift hours cover the whole society; a shift counts for at most 16 hours.

clock.noCamera: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings: a selfie is needed to start or end a shift.
clock.noLocation: No location: allow location access, or go on without it and your admin will review the shift.

notice.intro: To confirm shifts are worked at the society, starting and ending a shift records:
notice.selfie: a selfie taken now with the front camera,
notice.location: where your phone is at that moment (only then, never in between),
notice.who: seen only by the society admin, the tower admins and you,
notice.kept: deleted after 90 days. Your shift times are kept for the yearly review.

shifts.title: Review shifts
shifts.lead: Check that the selfies show the staff member and that they were at the society, then confirm or dispute each shift.
shifts.failed: The shifts could not be loaded.
shifts.emptyBody: No shifts match this period and filter.
shifts.inside: Inside the society ({{meters}} m from the centre)
shifts.noEvidence: No selfie or location (recorded before they were required).
shifts.reviewFailed: The review could not be saved. Try again.
shifts.ownShift: Your own shift: another admin reviews it.
